errors.name: BookNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested book is not found in the library system by book_id.

errors.name: MemberNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a requested member is not found in the system by member_id.

errors.name: BorrowRecordNotFoundError
errors.description: Raised when a borrow record is not found for a specific book_id and member_id combination.

errors.name: BookAlreadyBorrowedError
errors.description: Raised when an attempt is made to borrow a book that is already currently borrowed by another member.

errors.name: InvalidReturnDateError
errors.description: Raised when a return date is provided that is earlier than the borrow date in a return request.

errors.name: BookNotAvailableError
errors.description: Raised when a member tries to borrow a book that is not currently available (i.e., already borrowed).
